closedFindings: the historical mutable connector-definition row is superseded semantically by a six-table model that separates the logical connector aggregate from immutable definition versions
every canonical command/query header, transport required field, response field and owner execution enum is exact, while receipt state and execution state remain separate
IAQ-057 and IAQ-062 project one owner truth with exact distinct filters, sorts and field groups; owner receipt lineage stays server-side because the closed item schema does not serialize it

all opaque secret, mapping, sample, payload, provider-receipt, compensation, result and error-report references are resolved server-side and bound to trusted tenant, connector, purpose, type, namespace, digest and authorization evidence

PDX-007 and PDX-009 use explicit total coarse-state projections with reverse inference forbidden, and PDX-008 has total dry-run, import, export, dispatch, reconcile, direction and TENANT-or-LEGAL_ENTITY scope provenance
the shared V327 receipt store is reused and its guard must be append-only hardened in V334 so terminal receipts and illegal status transitions cannot be rewritten without changing the V327 checksum
definition and mapping subject columns are immutable, provider keys are tenant-connector-operation unique, and monotonic attempt fences prevent stale-worker or duplicate dispatch

execution, item and attempt matrices name exact enum targets plus guarded edges; every post-dispatch failure requires conclusive same-key evidence and ambiguous evidence enters or remains RESULT_UNKNOWN
retry creates only new monotonic attempts for the frozen retryable failed-item set; PARTIAL or FAILED exhausts to DEAD_LETTER without reopening prior attempts or successful items
post-dispatch cancellation requires terminal compensation evidence and atomically closes every nonterminal child item and attempt while preserving all terminal history
SYS-EVT-005 remains an atomic minimal outbox event containing public execution identity, state, counts and reconciliation digest without secrets, raw payload or employee item identity
the existing hcm.integration.execute meaning remains immutable; the SYS-008 execution capability collision can be resolved only in the next append-only central authorization successor
the feature remains default OFF with zero tenant, provider, route, menu and business-completion activation and no packet, token, worktree, lease or source authority
